commands_and_results: Source-specific preflight reconciled existing migration ledger, profile and recovery contracts; owned backup paths are absent and isolated task worktree is assigned.

Real disposable PostgreSQL and pg_dump checks are required, including interrupted dump and restored positive behavior. Encrypted remote retention, scoped production credentials and deployment qualification belong to later tasks.

Preserve the task documentation requirement: explicit mandatory size limits, no scheduling/RPO guarantee from a single dump, managed automated-backup/PITR complements and VM crash-consistent snapshot limits.
